text: The listener records the latest callback request that can be queried as nsIChannel. When completion succeeds, AsyncChannelOpener returns that channel and the buffered body, with the original channel as fallback. RequestBuilder builds Response from the returned channel, and Response reads status and headers from it. The selected opener/listener blobs persist unchanged at the fixed revision, whose actual response consumer was checked separately. Failed completion returns an error before this channel selection. This source pairing does not prove an actual redirect, retry, connection or native callback sequence.
title: Successful HTTP responses use the channel supplied by the stream listener
